chunks: And from him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from some of our companions, from whom he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"A child is born to us, we name him Muhammad; if seven days pass, if we wish we change [the name], and if not, we leave [it as it is]."
ai.seo_question: What is the practice of naming children according to Imam al-Sadiq (AS)?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the preeminence of the Prophet’s name within the Ahl al-Bayt, establishing 'Muhammad' as the primary designation for their offspring to honor the Seal of the Prophets. The flexibility to change the name after seven days reflects the practical tradition of the 'Aqiqah' ceremony, allowing the family to select a secondary name that may better suit the child's character or lineage while maintaining the initial honorific connection to the Prophet.
